new_cards.title: Ultra-Fast Optimal Pathfinding without Runtime Search
new_cards.takeaway: Compressed Path Databases answer optimal grid moves by lookup instead of runtime A*/JPS search.
new_cards.why: Static GRID COMMAND maps can trade preprocess memory for tiny first-move lag across many units.
ideas: Precompute all-pairs first moves; compress with rectangle/run-length encodings.
Runtime extracts optimal next step without expanding open lists.
Complements online pruning (JPS) when maps are mostly static.
First-move lag independent of path length.
caveats: Dynamic destructible terrain invalidates CPDs; hybrid with JPS/HPA* needed.
Memory/preprocess dominate for huge or frequently rebuilt maps.

new_cards.title: Example-Based Model Synthesis
new_cards.takeaway: Constraint-based example model synthesis is the direct algorithmic parent of Wave Function Collapse.
new_cards.why: Anoptic/GRID COMMAND PCG should cite Merrell when evaluating WFC-family layout generators.
ideas: Assemble large models from small example adjacency constraints.
Scanline/block modification differs from WFC entropy ordering.
Focused on 3D model assembly before 2016 WFC popularization.
Same CSP core later rediscovered as WFC.
caveats: Not identical to Gumin WFC; heuristic and failure recovery differ.
Heavy 3D instances need block partitioning.

new_cards.title: MarkovJunior
new_cards.takeaway: Probabilistic rewrite-rule PCG successor to WFC for hierarchical, multi-stage world generation.
new_cards.why: Living craft tool for multi-scale RTS/colony map grammars beyond single-pass WFC.
ideas: Rewrite rules as first-class PCG programs.
Can embed WFC-like constraint steps inside a Markov program.
Hierarchical generation in one framework.
Same author lineage as WaveFunctionCollapse.
caveats: Craft software, not a peer-reviewed theory paper.
Rule authoring skill dominates quality.

new_cards.title: Brief Announcement: Hazard Eras — Non-Blocking Memory Reclamation
new_cards.takeaway: Hazard Eras combine epoch-style clocks with hazard-pointer progress for faster non-blocking SMR.
new_cards.why: Drop-in HP alternative for Anoptic lock-free structures that traverse many nodes.
ideas: Era clock + per-thread reservations instead of per-pointer hazards.
Matches HP worst case; large wins on linked structures.
Implements with C11/C++11 atomics.
Bridges EBR throughput and HP progress guarantees.
caveats: Brief announcement; read full tech report before production port.
Retire-heavy queues may still prefer classic hazard pointers.

ideas: meshopt_buildMeshlets balances reuse vs cluster cone/radius.

Artificial pressure for surface tension/distribution.
Vorticity confinement post-process.

new_cards.title: Position Based Dynamics

ideas: Replace force integration with iterative position constraints.
Stable stiff constraints at game timesteps.

Screenspace approximation — no scene BVH.

Parent of HBAO refinements.

Handlers as first-class control.

Grace periods instead of per-pointer hazards.

Progress differs from hazard pointers under starvation.

Dynamic replanning lineage (D*/Field D*).
